Locates the delete and stale comment, rejects the keep-stripping comment, recommends deleting the defense, marks ignorable as host-owned not to be deleted (distinguishing code from marker), and notes the literal currently makes the delete a no-op.

Applies host-owned-marker semantics to the third-party producer, but never explains that ignorable:true is allowed only for informational events old readers may omit without breaking reconstruction, nor that retention is not reader-side filtering (marked events remain in the log).
